helpIntro: Emory College uses a 4.0 credit-hour-weighted GPA. Enter completed or planned Emory College courses to estimate your current, cumulative, projected, or target GPA.
helpNote: For Emory College undergraduates. S/U, transfer/transient and ARCHE work are excluded from the GPA. Law and several graduate/professional schools use different grading rules. Repeat treatment is not automated because the current public College policy does not specify enough detail for a safe repeat-impact estimate.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.0 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9; together, 25.9 ÷ 7 = 3.700.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.0 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 quality points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 quality point per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0 quality points; attempted letter-graded hours remain in the GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.IF: Incomplete failure is treated as F for GPA calculation.
gradeExplanations.WF: Withdrawal failing is treated as F for GPA calculation.
gradeExplanations.S: Satisfactory earns credit but is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.U: Unsatisfactory on S/U basis is excluded from GPA and earns no credit.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary and excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.IP: In progress is temporary and excluded until a final grade is posted.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal without penalty is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.WU: Unsatisfactory withdrawal is excluded from GPA under the Emory College grading rules.
gradeExplanations.IU: Incomplete on an S/U course is excluded from GPA.

specialTypes.name: Emory College course
specialTypes.note: Use final Emory College letter or S/U grade and Emory credit hours.

specialTypes.name: Transfer or transient credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted external credit may count toward degree requirements, but the external grade does not enter the Emory GPA.

specialTypes.name: ARCHE cross-registration
specialTypes.note: ARCHE courses post as credit only, not grades, on the Emory academic record.

specialTypes.name: Course in another Emory school with different grading rules
specialTypes.note: Do not apply the Emory College scale automatically to Law, graduate, public-health, or other school-specific grading systems.

repeatPolicy.note: For a repeated course, use your official Emory GPA baseline or confirm the repeat treatment with Emory College before modeling the change.
